title: Morning Old Québec Walking Tour with coffee for Early Birds
blurb:
If your cruise docks early or you simply enjoy starting your day ahead of the crowd, no worries we’ll be there to welcome you! Wake up with Old Québec before the city gets busy.

Stroll the charming streets of Old Quebec and soak in the historic atmosphere of one of North America’s oldest cities. Visit many of Québec City’s top attractions in the Upper and Lower Town districts, including Fairmont Le Château Frontenac, Terrasse Dufferin, Notre-Dame de Québec Basilica-Cathedral, Place Royale, Fortifications of Québec, and Quartier Petit Champlain, all enriched with engaging stories.

Enjoy a scenic funicular ride up to the Upper Town, admiring views of the St. Lawrence River. If the funicular is unavailable, we can arrange a cab ride or provide a ticket to use later, at your discretion. 

A 15–20% tip for your guide is strongly recommended at the end of the visit.
